notes: Only claims explicitly scoped below are supported; original editions/final independent review still pending.

sources.title: Christiaan Huygens, De Ratiociniis in Ludo Aleae, 1714 Browne English translation
Anders Hald, Huygens and De Ratiociniis in Ludo Aleae (1990)

claims.statement: Huygens De ratiociniis in ludo aleae printed in 1657 as appendix to Van Schooten's mathematical exercises
claims.limitations: 1714 Browne English text is not Latin 1657 facsimile

claims.statement: Huygens propositions I and II set equal-chance expectation (a+b)/2 and (a+b+c)/3
claims.limitations: Do not falsely attribute modern random variable notation

claims.statement: Huygens proposition III treats p equal outcomes of value a and q of value b by (pa+qb)/(p+q)
claims.limitations: Only equal likelihood among underlying cases

claims.statement: His worked case 3 outcomes at 13 and 2 outcomes at 8 yields 11
His work included recursive treatment of the problem of points and several exercises
claims.limitations: Do not claim he originated every principle

claims.statement: Mean of equally likely outcomes 0 and 10 equals 5 but uncertainty differs from a constant five
claims.limitations: Equal expectations do not imply equal risk, preference or realized outcomes

claims.statement: Linearity of expectation E[X+Y]=E[X]+E[Y] holds without independence for finite defined expectations
claims.limitations: Later formalization; not Huygens' original modern notation
